reviews.t: Does what it claims.
reviews.x: So, I've been using this brush for a good 5 months. The brush does what it claims to be able to do. The thing is, it's horse hair. This means that they will be softer than boar bristles. It's very good, and effective for short beards, or soft hair; I have VERY coarse hair. It's awesome for the mustache! If you have coarse hair, or a beard with an inch, or longer hair, this won't work for you. You can try, but don't blame the product if it doesn't work. Breaking it down to pros and cons: Pros: A

reviews.t: Coarse beard = get different brush
reviews.x: Works in a pinch but really not a great beard brush if you have coarse beard hair. The bristles don't do as much brushing as they give way to the hair and just get bent by the beard. I used another hair brush here on Amazon and that one stays firm through the whole brush. Really hoped this would work well as I liked the small size.

reviews.t: Excellent Quality, Exceeded my expectations
reviews.x: Just got it earlier today, April 1st 2017 and I am very happy about the quality and results. It worked very well on my short beard and mustache, while being gentle on my skin. Nice metal case as well, very practical. I will update my review incase something changed, but so far, I HIGHLY recommend it, buy with confidence

reviews.t: The hairs fall out like crazy not happy with the product going to send ...
reviews.x: Save your money. The hairs fall out like crazy not happy with the product going to send back.

reviews.t: Well worth the money.
reviews.x: I seriously love this brush. I've struggled from time to time keeping my beard because it can be bothersome, but since having this brush I've been able to keep my beard for longer without feeling the compulsion to shave it. After a few strokes my beard hairs are in alignment and it's much more comfortable. Highly recommend for anyone who also has trouble with beard comfort. In addition it's nice and compact so it's easy to store and travel with. Personally I keep it on my desk to brush my beard

reviews.t: Easy to carry, good quality, NOT BOAR bristle which is good for me
reviews.x: Everything is fine with this item but bristles are falling sometimes but not too much. It is not a big deal. But it is cute, easy to grab and carry and use. And it is good for muslim or people who are not using boar bristles for any reason. I am a person who are trying to not use boar bristles after I recognize it is made by pig. So this product is almost one the best horse bristle that you can find in Amazon.

reviews.t: Great Beard Brush!
reviews.x: I love this brush. My only issue is that the bristles could be a bit stiffer.Otherwise, I have nothing but good things to say about the product. I also noticed that when I brushed my beard and it was slightly wet the brush took on a minor smell, but I believe this to be evidence of the quality of the bristles. It is to be expected with the natural hair used.

reviews.t: Ok brush, shame about the misplaced logo.
reviews.x: Brush is small and compact and does the job. However, from the pictures in the product discription it looked like there was no logo. But upon receiving the brush, I found a logo on the bottom right of the brush. Would of preferred no logo, than an obviously miss stamped one, makes the brush look cheap.

reviews.t: Falling apart out of the container
reviews.x: The bristles are not very firm and don't really move my beard that well. The bigger problem is the bristles just keep falling out. This brush, right out of the container, is literally falling apart. If you are looking for a brush, look else where

reviews.t: One Star
reviews.x: Purchased for my husband, was delivered without the brush. Only an empty canister. Help!

reviews.t: Brush looks different than what is advertised. Check my photos out before you buy this!
reviews.x: My brush looks different than what is advertised. Check my photos before you buy this!

reviews.t: New to beards
reviews.x: I grew a beard for the first time recently. I noticed it was getting a bit unkempt. I did buy a balm first, but my beard is coming in thick so the balm doesn't get past the surface. So I bought this simple brush and noticed not only it feels good on my beard, but also helps to distribute the balm.  So why not five stars? I don't feel wowed by this. It is a brush, after all. But for the money, I'm happy. And my beard looks pretty good, too!

reviews.t: It's small and easy to carry around
reviews.x: Fabulous beard brush!!  It's small and easy to carry around, plus it's super soft on the skin.  Works great as a soft brush; if you're looking for something w/ more coarse bristles you'll probably want to check out different products.  (i.e. this brush works great as a general beard brush to smooth down the ol' whiskers, but for combing your mustache/shaping/etc. something w/ stiffer bristles would probably work better.)

reviews.t: Worth it
reviews.x: So to start the product comes exactly as shown.  Light weight wood handle and a tin case.  The product workers well enough but the one thing I have to say is I'd wish the bristles where a bit stiffer.  They are quite soft so others no skin irritation but for someone with a thicker beard it doesn't penetrate the first layer or so of hair.  Over all a good product for the price, you can't go wrong.

reviews.t: Love the shape because it fits perfectly into the tin ...
reviews.x: Love the shape because it fits perfectly into the tin of all-natural beeswax beard balm I make for my husband, but he says the bristles are too soft to get through his beard.  If you are looking for a brush that fits into beard balm tins, this is for you.  Also, if you want a brush that glazes over the top of the beard just to put on product, then this brush is also for you.

reviews.t: Amazing works wonderfully
reviews.x: From using a normal hair brush every morning to this.  Does not irritate my face and brushes my beard to the way i want it.  Feels lovely on the skin.  Use this with my bear balm every morning and keeps everything looking neat for my office job.  Would be buying more of these as gifts for the guys in my family.

reviews.t: Best Brush Value for the Money
reviews.x: I love the brush. I use it every morning with my beard balm. The bristles are soft and effective. The can the brush is packaged in is great for both storage and travel. I'll be purchasing a second to keep at work! I'd highly recommend getting either yourself or your bearded friend The Beard Brush.

reviews.t: It is a really good brush. soft enough to where it doesn't scratch ...
reviews.x: It is a really good brush. soft enough to where it doesn't scratch your face off but hard enough to train your beard hairs to go in the direction you need it to  grow. Love this. It's also good for evening out any beard oils or balms you put on your face so that everything goes on evenly.

reviews.t: Nice, small, and portable
reviews.x: Nice, small, and portable. It's smooth brush and massages the face well. After a few weeks of use my only complaint is that some bristles fall off every once in a while. I like my brushes to not have their bristles fall off. Aside from that, it is pretty good.

reviews.t: Love it!
reviews.x: I've been using this brush now for a few weeks and I am very satisfied with it. It's a great quality item. I use it several times a daily. It small and store neatly in its container. I will get another one to keep handy at my office. Highly recommend!!

reviews.t: I really like the size and quality and density of the brush
reviews.x: I really like the size and quality and density of the brush. Its great for short hair beads and I even use it to brush my short cut hair on my head! Its so compact that i vought another one for my car so I can have a neatly combed beard at all times.

reviews.t: Soft Bristles.
reviews.x: It's okay, but it doesn't get down into the depths of my beard (which isn't too thick) to truly brush it. The bristles are too soft to sink in. They just skim the surface. I still need to use a comb for the lower layers of hair.

reviews.t: I do like portability and the awesomeness of the tin can though
reviews.x: It's OK.  The bristles doesn't get in there as I had hoped. I have some coarse whiskers.  The hairs on these seem to cower and bend to the touch of my beard.  I do like portability and the awesomeness of the tin can though!

reviews.t: Little soft, but a great value
reviews.x: Bristles are a little soft for me, but it's the size I like and for a great price! My beard is long, and wiry, so I prefer boar bristles, which have a bit more backbone than the horse hairs that this one is made out of.

reviews.t: My husband really liked this brush
reviews.x: My husband really liked this brush.  He says it's great for applying his beard balm & beard oils, and for just straightening out his beard.  Bonus:  Now he'll stop using my hair brush for this! ;)

claims.text: Many reviewers find the bristles too soft, especially for coarse or thick beards, saying they bend or don't get through the hair.
Several reviewers report bristles falling out, sometimes heavily and even right out of the container.
Reviewers praise the brush as small, compact, and easy to carry, often noting the practical metal tin case.
Positive reviewers say it works well and gently on short beards and mustaches, smoothing and aligning beard hair.
A few reviewers complain the product received did not match the advertised photos or arrived incomplete.
